posts.text: As Trump has ordered red states to redesign their congressional district maps before the midterms, Virginia is trying to push back through a referendum that allows voters to decide what to do. But time is running out: the referendum expires April 21 and democracy is on the line. Here’s what you can do. More here >> https://act.link/gi-P2jAgL

Many are celebrating the fact that oil prices have plummeted 10% after the Strait of Hormuz  reopened.  But there’s very little to celebrate because oil prices are still up over 25% versus where they were before the war in Iran started.  let’s fact check @TheRealJustJen  #oilprices #straitofhormuz #iranwar

There is a substantial difference between the image shared by Trump of him, performing miracles, and the depiction of the opening ceremony of the 2024 Paris Olympics showing a feast of gods.  Let’s set @Randomnessguy straight

Some people compare the concept of birthright citizenship indicated in the 14th amendment to the constitution with the idea of a stranger walking into somebody’s home and delivering a baby, and expecting that baby to become part of the family. That example, shared by people like @Victor N , mixes two concepts: relations between private individuals, and relations between those individuals and the government.

Donald Trump’s net worth is now $6.5 billion and has increased by billions of dollars since he was sworn in as the 47th President in 2025 Billions of dollars in value are thanks to crypto currency, which Trump has created and then regulated through executive orders.
Pete Hegseth tries to pray during an event at the Pentagon. The only problem? He recited a monologue from Pulp Fiction, and not a prayer from the Bible.
Everything Donald Trump does is strategic, says @𝕻𝖆𝖙𝖗𝖎𝖔𝖙𝕯𝖆𝖉ᵉᵛ3.0  So the sacrilegious image he posted was also strategic?

Does Virginia HB965 strip Virginia citizens of their constitutional right to vote for the president? Quite the contrary.  VA HB965 is a so-called interstate compact designed to allow the President to be selected by popular vote and not by electoral college vote.  It won’t go into effect until and unless enough states pass a similar law to make up 270 electoral votes.

An ad running ties Virginia’s redistricting referendum to civil rights. The truth is that the ad was funded by dark money groups who are tied to other national efforts to disenfranchise working class voters in favor of special interest groups.  Let’s follow the money trail.

As April 15, the deadline to file America’s income tax return, approaches, millions of Americans have to use services from private companies like intuit TurboTax and H&R Block, now that the government has ended the free tax filing program #incometax #trumpadministration
